reference.crossCheckedWith: docs/evidence/libbluray-1.5.0-igs-baseline.json (libbluray 1.5.0 graphics_processor_decode_ts decodes the same 913 object ids)

encoding.asset: [id, width, height, pixels, samplesHex, anchorsHex, firstOpaque, lastOpaque, channelBins]
encoding.samplesHex: 48 evenly spaced RGBA pixels, 8 hex chars each
encoding.anchorsHex: 3x3 fixed-grid RGBA pixels, 8 hex chars each
encoding.firstOpaque: [x, y, rrggbbaa] of the first non-transparent pixel, or null
encoding.lastOpaque: [x, y, rrggbbaa] of the last non-transparent pixel, or null
encoding.channelBins: 64 counts: for each of R,G,B,A, 16 bins of the high nibble of the channel value
encoding.note: Exact per-element RGBA pixel samples and channel distributions from the independent reference renderer. docs/evidence/igs-fixture-packet-comparison-summary.json records differentPixels=0 for the same nine clips.
